Fees paid by PAR and paUSD borrowers in the Classic Vaults: the borrowing fee (interest), the 0.2% origination fee and the liquidation fee, all added to the vaults' debt. Measured as the change in the income accrued by each VaultsCore (the debt above the PAR or paUSD the core minted, as VaultsCoreState.availableIncome() computes it, plus the interest accrued since each collateral type's last refresh), plus the income released by the FeeDistributor that day.

20% of the fees, minted by the FeeDistributor to the Insurance Fund, which covers the vaults' bad debt.

The 15% of the fees for PRL holders since 1 May 2025, 0 before, measured at the fee source as that share of the day's fees. It is passed on to PRL stakers (sPRL1, sPRL2) through the RewardMerkleDistributor, and read from the FeeDistributor's payees. Under PGP-42, from 25 May to 31 August 2026, the DAO Treasury received that 15% to buy PRL back and burn it: a buyback funded by the fees, counted here at the fee source. September 2026, paid to PRL stakers by hand by the DAO Treasury on 1 October 2026, counts as staking rewards. The buybacks the DAO Treasury pays from its own holdings are not counted.

Net gaming revenue (NGR) settled to the bankroll, measured as WINR received via ProfitReceived minus WINR paid out via LossCovered. This is an NGR figure standing in for a Fees field that conventionally carries GGR: gross wagered turnover is not observable on-chain because games run off-chain, and creator rewards, affiliate commissions and VIP cashback are already deducted in the off-chain escrow ledger before settlement. NGR is the most complete figure derivable from chain data, and this is a known limitation rather than an omission.

Zero. No protocol share is deducted on-chain - a 30 day reconciliation shows 100% of settled net gaming revenue accruing to bankroll liquidity providers through share price appreciation, with no leakage to any other on-chain party. The protocol does capture revenue at the application layer, but it is charged and accounted entirely off-chain and is not derivable from chain data, so it is deliberately not estimated here.

Trading and liquidation fees paid by traders on Extended perpetuals. Until 2026-10-21 they are summed from the per-trade fee (Trade events) and liquidation fee (Liquidation events) fields of Extended's trading contract on Starknet. From 2026-10-22, when settlement moved to Arc, which posts no per-trade fees on-chain, they are the daily fees reported by Extended's stats API. Per Extended's fee schedule, takers pay 0.025% and makers pay 0.000% with a tiered rebate up to 0.013% based on 30-day maker market share. Maker rebates are accrued to internal Extended sub-accounts rather than paid out on-chain, so they cannot be separately attributed and are not netted from this value. Revenue is therefore left unreported rather than implicitly equated to fees.

Taker fees paid by users, computed as Θ × C × p × (1 - p), where C is contracts and p is trade price. Θ = 0.0695 from 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-16, Θ = 0.06 from 12:00 AM ET 2026-07-01, Θ = 0.05 from 2026-04-04, flat 1% from 2026-01-09 to 2026-04-03. Table Tennis markets pay Θ = 0.10 from 10:00 AM ET 2026-10-07 until 1:00 PM ET 2026-11-06. From 1:00 PM ET 2026-11-06 Θ is set per account by trailing 30-day taker volume (0.095 below $10k down to 0.0695 at $250k+); the public trade files carry no account, so the lowest tier (0.0695) is applied to every trade and fees from that date are a lower bound. Combo trades (launched 2026-08-11) use the same formula until 11:59 PM ET 2026-09-24, then pay C × p × [Θ × (1 - p) + k × (1 - p)^4], with k = 0.04, raised to 0.06 from 10:00 AM ET 2026-10-01, to 0.085 from 10:00 PM ET 2026-10-28 and back to 0.06 from 1:00 PM ET 2026-11-11. Revenue breakdowns are not available due to lack of per-trader volume data.

Gross user-paid spend on render jobs under the Burn-Mint Equilibrium model (RNP-001). Each job is priced in USD; an equivalent USD value of RENDER is burned on the Solana SPL mint by the burn wallet. The on-chain burn represents the 95% node-operator side of gross job spend; gross fees are derived by dividing the burn value by 0.95. The remaining 5% Network Operator service fee is paid to OTOY off-chain per the Foundation's documented fee schedule and is not directly observed in the on-chain burn stream. Legacy Ethereum RNDR (pre-2023-11-02 Solana migration) is out of scope.

The 1inch DAO's encoded share of each fill's swap fee: 1/4 of the LP fee on low-fee tiers (below ~0.1225%) and 1/6 on higher tiers, transferred to the purpose-deployed per-chain DAO fee exchanger at fill time. Positions created before the DAO fee launch (2026-07-19; enabled 2026-07-21 on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain) carry no DAO fee and contribute only to SupplySideRevenue. Cross-checked against measured ERC20 inflows to the fee exchangers.
All DAO revenue accrues to the 1inch DAO treasury.

The share of each fill's swap fee retained by the LP inside the maker-owned wallet (Aqua is non-custodial): total fee minus the DAO share. Fees a maker's own strategies pay each other within one transaction are excluded.

Realized trading fees: USDW collateral collected by the Hermes FeeVault, valued 1:1 as USDC. Outcome-token fees are counted once redeemed to USDW at settlement, mirroring DefiLlama's Polymarket fees adapter.
All realized fees are retained by the protocol.
Trading fees paid by GreenTown users.
Trading fees paid on GreenTown creator key buys and sells.
The protocol share of GreenTown trading fees.
Creator and referrer shares of GreenTown trading fees.
x402 pay-per-call fees paid by AI agents for Barker's MCP stablecoin-yield tools ($0.001–$0.05 per call), settled onchain in stablecoins to the protocol payment wallet.
All x402 call fees paid by AI agents are kept by the protocol.
1.25% trade fee (0.95% protocol + 0.30% creator) on every curve trade, plus the flat migration fee skimmed when a token graduates to Based DEX.
Protocol share of trade fees (0.95% of each trade) plus migration fees.
Same as Revenue — all protocol fees(0.95% of each trade) and migration fees accrue to the protocol.
Creator share of trade fees (0.30%), claimable by each token's creator.
Users pay a platform fee of 1.5% on presales and memecoin transactions on Gunfun.
Protocol collects a 1.5% fee on all presales and memecoin transactions.
Taker fees paid on combo position trades.
All taker fees on combo trades go to Polymarket.
Users pay the full 0.25% swap fee charged by V2 pairs.
Traders pay a 0.25% fee on every V2 swap.
32% of V2 swap fees go to the protocol while feeTo is enabled on the factory.
32% of V2 swap fees accrue to the protocol through LP token minting while feeTo is enabled.
Liquidity providers receive V2 swap fees minus the protocol share.
25% of each takeover, paid by players to the protocol envelope.
The protocol envelope of each takeover — Planted.price minus the previous-gardener payout — which is 25% of the payment by construction.
8.25% of each takeover goes to the protocol treasury.
Includes 10.5% of each takeover going to $FLOWR buybacks and the 6.25% staking distribution, live since 2026-07-11.
Builder code fees paid by users trading Hyperliquid perpetuals through StableJack.
Builder code fees collected by StableJack from Hyperliquid perpetual trades.
Builder fees received by SmartX from trades on Polymarket v2
Same as Fees — all fees are paid by traders.
1.25% fee on every bonding-curve trade (Buy/Sell ethFee), plus flat graduation and token-creation fees read from the factory config (currently 0.001 ETH and 0).
Protocol share of trading fees (0.95% of trade value via FeesAccrued) plus graduation and creation fees.

Creator share of trading fees (0.30% of trade value via FeesAccrued). Creators additionally receive a fixed one-off reward per graduation (currently 0.024 ETH), excluded here as it is an internal incentive transfer rather than a user fee.
API usage fees paid by users of the x402.miroshark.xyz simulation API ($1.00 USDC per simulation run), settled on Base via x402 (gasless EIP-3009 USDC transfers submitted by x402 facilitators).
All API fees accrue to MiroShark — there is no supply side and facilitators charge no on-chain cut.
All API fees accrue to MiroShark.

Dynamic swap fee (1.2% steady-state) paid by users trading on the WETH/AEON Uniswap v4 pool on Base, plus client payments for paid security work received by the dedicated Aeon client payments wallet. Liquidity is protocol-owned multicurve positions, there are no third-party LPs.
57% of swap fees routed to the Aeon treasury, per the on-chain beneficiary split read from the multicurve initializer, plus all client payments for security work.
57% of swap fees plus client payments for security work kept by Aeon, minus what the treasury spends on $aeon buybacks.
43% of swap fees going to the launch platform beneficiaries (Bankr/Doppler & interface), per the on-chain beneficiary split.
$aeon bought back on the market by the Aeon wallets (deployer wallet and treasury Safe) and kept by the treasury.
1% swap fees paid on all token swaps of tokens launched on the platform (only pools with at least $200 in TVL are included) and 0.0005 $ETH per token launched.

Part of swap fees retained by the protocol (exact fee share extracted from the protocolFeeShare function, only pools with at least $200 in TVL are included) and all the launch fees (0.0005 $ETH per token launched).
Revenue minus the $PONS bought back and burnt.
Includes one-sixth of swap fees (routed to Uniswap after July 27, 2026, and zero before that), as well as the portion of swap fees paid to token creators after protocol revenue is deducted.
Around 80% of revenue is used to buyback and burn $PONS tokens.
Dynamic swap fee (1.2% steady-state) paid by users trading on the WETH/MiroShark Uniswap v4 pool on Base. Liquidity is protocol-owned multicurve positions, there are no third-party LPs.
57% of swap fees routed to MiroShark, per the on-chain beneficiary split read from the multicurve initializer.
57% of swap fees routed to MiroShark.
Swap fees are not distributed to token holders directly.

Gross Uniswap V3/V4 LP fees collected by Quiver vault strategies, taken from Harvest events (fees realize when harvested or rebalanced; small fee amounts settled inline during V4 withdrawals are not tracked).

Treasury share of harvested LP fees (totalBps minus the caller incentive callerBps, read live from FeeConfig), sent to the protocol treasury. Excludes the caller incentive, which is paid to whoever calls harvest, not the protocol.

The remaining share of harvested LP fees after the full performance fee (totalBps) is taken, compounded back into vault positions for depositors, plus the caller incentive (callerBps) paid to whoever calls harvest.
Swap fees directly paid by traders.
Total v2 swap fees paid by traders, valued on the same pricing side used for volume. Fees use PoolFactory.getFee(pool, stable), where 30 means 0.30%.
V2 swap fees routed to veUP voters through gauges, equal to HoldersRevenue.
V2 liquidity provider fees not routed to veUP voters.
V2 pool fees attributable to staked gauge LP share, estimated from pool.balanceOf(gauge) / pool.totalSupply.
Total concentrated liquidity swap fees paid by traders, valued on the same pricing side used for volume. Fees use CLPool.fee(), where 3000 means 0.30%.
Concentrated liquidity fees routed to veUP voters through gauges, equal to HoldersRevenue.
Concentrated liquidity provider fees not routed to veUP voters.
Voter fee share is measured from CLPool.gaugeFees() deltas plus CollectFees events and applied per token.

Uniswap LP swap fees collected from Quiver-locked positions when collectRewards runs. Quiver does not charge a separate native launch fee; optional launch-tx ETH is a same-tx Uniswap buy, not a Quiver fee. Liquidity principal and gas are excluded. Trading volume is not counted (ordinary Uniswap activity).
Portion of collected LP fees credited to the Quiver protocol fee recipient (factory.teamFeeRecipient).
Portion of collected LP fees credited to token creators (and any other non-protocol reward recipients configured at launch).
Builder code fees paid by users whose Hyperliquid perpetual trades are executed through Signalview.
Builder code fees collected by Signalview from Hyperliquid perpetual trades.

Safety Deposit Box liquidity-locker protocol cuts (Uniswap V3/V4 + up. DEX v2/CL lockers) from LockFeesCollected / LockLiquidityDecreased / LockTokensPaid; LP trading fees claimed through the locked positions (the lock owner's 80% share of LockFeesCollected plus gauge rewards from LockTokensPaid); and StonkVestingLocker 0.01% deposit fees.
10% of locker protocol cuts and vesting-locker deposit fees.
10% of locker protocol cuts → protocol wallet; vesting-locker deposit fees → SafetyDepositClockInV3.
90% of locker protocol cuts → SafetyDepositClockIn broker claims, and the lock owners' 80% share of locked-LP trading fees + gauge rewards claimed through the lockers.
Swappers pay the creator-chosen Uniswap V4 pool fee (1%-5% per token) on every trade in a Diggers pool.
LP fees generated by Diggers pools. Diggers is the only LP of every pool it creates, so all LP fees accrue to the protocol's harvest split. Fees are valued on the ETH leg of each swap.
The team share of ETH fees (on-chain teamShareWad, currently 30%) plus the 10% platform-token slice while the $DIG airdrop window is live.
The team share of ETH fees plus the platform-token slice while the airdrop window is live.

The creator share of ETH fees (remainder after team/platform), paid to each token's creator fee-split table via pull-payment claims. The token-side fee split (burn + daily traders-airdrop pot) is denominated in the launched tokens and not valued here.
Trading fees paid directly by bot.fun traders.
Trading fees paid by users on bot.fun bonding-curve buys and sells.
Trading fees remaining after creator and referral allocations. The protocol currently sends this share to the zero address.
Zero while the bot.fun treasury is configured as the zero address.
Trading fees accrued to coin creators and referrers.
The protocol share of trading fees burned as native TIA.
Traders pay the full swap fee on every trade.
Swap fees paid by traders across GIGA DEX Classic (stable + volatile) and BrownFi oracle-based pools, per-pair fee rate read on-chain.

Share of swap fees collected by the GIGA fee center for veGIGA stakers, read per pair on-chain (pair.protocolFee() on Classic, feeSplit on BrownFi): 100% on gauged pairs (pairs receiving GIGA emissions), 3% on non-gauged Classic pairs.
The protocol treasury keeps no direct share of swap fees, it earns as a veGIGA staker.
Share of swap fees kept by liquidity providers: 0% on gauged pairs (LPs there earn GIGA emissions instead), 97% on non-gauged Classic pairs, the non-feeSplit part on BrownFi pairs.
Share of swap fees distributed to veGIGA stakers (all of the protocol's share).
Swap fees paid by traders on GIGA DEX CL pools, per the pool's fee tier.
Share of swap fees collected by the GIGA fee center for veGIGA stakers, read per pool from slot0.feeProtocol: 100% on gauged pools (pools receiving GIGA emissions), 3% on non-gauged pools.
Share of swap fees kept by liquidity providers: 0% on gauged pools (LPs there earn GIGA emissions instead), 97% on non-gauged pools.
1.25% fee on every bonding-curve trade, 0.40% paid to the token creator and 0.85% allocated to the PEEPS.WTF platform and ecosystem.
0.85% platform fee from every bonding-curve trade, allocated to the PEEPS.WTF platform and ecosystem.
0.40% creator fee from every bonding-curve trade, paid to the creator of the launched token.
A 1.25% fee charged on the ETH leg of every bonding-curve buy and sell, read per trade from the Trade event's protocolFee and creatorFee fields. HoodMint has no launch fee and no graduation fee.
The protocol slice of the bonding-curve trade fee.
Same as Revenue — the protocol slice of the bonding-curve trade fee.
The creator slice of the bonding-curve trade fee, claimable by each token's creator.
The 1% Uniswap V3 pool fee paid on every swap of tokens launched via ArrowPad (measured on the WETH leg).
The protocol's immutable 20% share of the pool fees.
The 80% share of pool fees that streams to the token creators.
All fees paid by traders on the Lighter Robinhood perpetuals deployment: maker, taker, transfer, withdrawal and liquidation fees. Scoped to perp markets (spot is tracked separately as lighter-spot).
Protocol revenue from maker, taker, transfer and withdrawal fees. Liquidation fees are excluded — they go to the LLP (see SupplySideRevenue).
Same as Revenue: maker, taker, transfer and withdrawal fees retained by the protocol.
Liquidation fees, which are paid to the Lighter Liquidity Pool (LLP) — i.e. to liquidity providers, not the protocol.
Builder code fees paid by users trading Hyperliquid perps via CCXT.
Builder code fees collected by CCXT from Hyperliquid perps trades.
Builder code fees paid by users trading Hyperliquid perps via Owly.fi.
Builder code fees collected by Owly.fi from Hyperliquid perps trades.

Total borrow interest paid by borrowers: for every trade, the face value of the debt (units) minus the loan tokens the borrower received (sellerAssets), i.e. the fixed-rate discount locked in at execution.
Protocol fees kept by Morpho: the settlement fee (taker-paid spread on each trade) plus the continuous fee accrued on new lender credit. Both are disabled at launch, so Revenue is currently 0.
Same as Revenue: settlement fee plus continuous fee. Currently 0 while both fees are disabled.
Interest distributed to lenders: total borrow interest minus the protocol settlement and continuous fees.
Router-skim fee deducted from every Swapped event (currently 0.60%), hard-capped at 1.00% per route.
All the router-skim fees deducted from each swap accrue to the protocol treasury.
Same as Fees — all fees are paid by players out of their deployed ETH.

Fees extracted per round: 1% admin fee on all deployed ETH, 1% admin fee on the losers pool, and a 10% vault fee on the losers pool after admin. On rounds where nobody hit the winning block, the entire pot (minus the admin fee) is routed to the Treasury vault. Variable effective rate depending on winner/loser ratio.
All extracted fees: the sum of protocol revenue (admin fees) and holders revenue (vault fees).
Admin fees (1% of deployed ETH + 1% of losers pool) accruing to the protocol fee wallet.
Vault fee ETH funds automated PEA buybacks — 95% of bought PEA is permanently burned, 5% is distributed to PEA stakers as yield.
Total Uniswap V3 trading fees earned by all AutoRange vaults' positions, realized on rebalance or when the vault owner manually claims — the full amount before the platform/owner split.
The platform's performance-fee cut of those trading fees, set per-vault by PlatformConfig and capped by the vault owner.
The vault owner's (LP's) net share of trading fees, after the platform's cut.

All fees generated by the protocol: the 1% trade fee on bonding-curve buys/sells, token taxes (curve phase and post-graduation DEX phase, counted when the TaxProcessor realizes them), and graduation fees (fixed migration fee + dust). Legs denominated in the launched tokens themselves are not counted.

Protocol revenue: the 1% curve trade fee, graduation fees, and the protocol fee bucket of tax dispatches. RH.fun has no protocol token, so there is no holders revenue and Revenue equals ProtocolRevenue.
The 1% curve trade fee, graduation fees, and the protocol fee bucket of tax dispatches.
Token tax routed to the launched token's own side: market recipients (creator/community), token-holder dividends, buyback-and-burn, and permanently locked liquidity.

On Base/Robinhood: gross Doppler pool trading fees (2.5%), extrapolated from Squeeze’s 47.5% Doppler fee-collect receipts. On Solana: LaunchLab *platform* fees claimed to Squeeze’s claim wallet only (not creator/protocol/referral cuts).
Squeeze platform share — EVM: 47.5% of Doppler swap fees claimed via collectFees; Solana: LaunchLab platform fees to the claim wallet.
On EVM: extrapolated creator share (47.5%) and Doppler protocol-owner share (5%). On Solana: not attributed in v1 (those cuts never hit the Squeeze claim wallet).
Swap fees paid by traders, borrow interest paid by borrowers into LP reserves, and protocol-retained lending fees paid by borrowers and over-repayers.

Swap fees inferred from each swap's actual input minus the no-fee input required by the pre-swap reserve invariant for the observed output, the LP reserve-growth portion of borrow interest emitted by InterestAccrued, and protocol-retained lending fees minted to the Ammalgam fee recipient. Ammalgam swap fees are dynamic; see https://docs.ammalgam.xyz/docs/developer-guide/contracts/libraries/QuadraticSwapFees.
Protocol-retained lending fees minted to the Ammalgam fee recipient. No protocol fees are taken from swaps.
Swap fees and the LP reserve-growth portion of borrow interest accrue to liquidity providers.
Uniswap V3 swap fees accrued on each launched token's pool, collected via the AaroLauncher contract.
The 20% treasury share of collected swap fees.
The 80% creator share of collected swap fees.

Gross accumulated ticket fees recognized when WindfallFeeShare emits FeeDistributed. Recognition is aligned with the allocation period so gross fees equal protocol revenue plus supply-side revenue in every reporting window.
The portion of each FeeDistributed amount allocated to hostTreasury. Donor shareholder payouts are excluded and classified as supply-side revenue.
The hostTreasury allocation, including all host shares and the integer-division remainder assigned exclusively to the host.
The portion of each FeeDistributed amount allocated to active donor shareholders. Each active donor receives one distribution share.

Net yield earned by Unitas strategies on XAUt-backed XGLD, estimated from the exchange rate increase credited to XGLD holders and their documented 80% share. Excludes the USDu product (tracked in fees/unitas-usdu).

The 80% of net strategy yield credited to XGLD holders through the exchange rate (NAV) increase and the 10% set aside in the Insurance Fund that backs XGLD holders. Excludes XGLD held on Base, which is immaterial.
Traders pay the 1% trade fee; there is no token-creation fee.

A flat 1% fee on every trade, valued in USDT0: charged by the bonding curve on legacy v1 tokens, and by the 1% Uniswap v3 pool tier on v2/v3 tokens. Buy-side pool fees are charged on the USDT0 input (exact); sell-side pool fees are charged in the traded token and valued as their USDT0 equivalent at that swap's own price (usdtOut/99).
50% of every trade fee accrues to the Prismapad treasury.
50% of every trade fee accrues to the launched token's creator (v1: claimable from the launchpad; v2/v3: collected from the locked pool position).
The 10% rake taken from every round's pot: 6% to veSTEEL stakers, 2% to the keeper, and 2% to the motherlode.
Gross profit: 6% distributed to veSTEEL stakers plus the 2% keeper cut.
The 2% keeper self-funding cut retained by the protocol.
The 2% of each pot routed to the motherlode, paid back out to winning players.
All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veSTEEL stakers (RewardNotified events on VeSteelV2).
Net Acquisition fees paid by NFT purchasers, plus settlement fees taken from listing backings.
Team share of the protocol's cut of acquisition and settlement fees, plus the part of the cut spent on FWA that is burned.
Team share of the protocol's fee cut, per the Splitter contract's live split, minus the FWA-token buybacks counted under HoldersRevenue.

Share of net acquisition fees distributed to NFT depositors (equal split across active listings plus the top-listing pot), the snapshot soulbound-NFT holders' share of protocol fees via the Splitter, and the FWA rewards to depositors and purchasers and the caller incentive paid from buybacks.
FWA bought back with protocol fees and burned, plus retroactive scheduled buybacks funded from previously earned team fees.
All Uniswap V3 trading fees collected by the positions each Tirelire Hypervisor manages, summed on-chain from ZeroBurn events.
The 10% performance fee taken from collected trading fees and sent to the protocol treasury (fees / fee, with the divisor read from each ZeroBurn event).
Same as Revenue — the 10% performance fee retained by the protocol treasury.
The 90% of collected trading fees that are compounded back to LPs.

Quote-denominated swap fees from Hook Trade events plus token-launch payment events across configured suites. Legacy launch-token-denominated swap fees are excluded because reliable historical USD valuation is unavailable. Crypto uses token balances; Stocks use the event-time factory tick reference price under the documented $4,000 opening-cap convention, with historical DefiLlama prices only when that reference is unavailable.

Actual platform and protocol-owned fixed-component swap credits, plus token-launch fees. Includes anti-snipe surcharges, referral fallback and rounding retained by the protocol. Claims do not count again.
Swap and launch fees retained by the protocol treasury.
Actual swap credits allocated to creators and referrers, including amounts still unclaimed.

Odinbot charges a 1% fee on copy-trades (min 0.001 SOL for spot copy trades and 0.1% of position size for perpetual copy trades). Total fees are the protocol share received by the Odin fee wallet plus affiliate payouts in the same transaction.
The 60% (100% if no referral code is applied) protocol share of Odinbot trading fees retained after affiliate payouts.
The 40% affiliate commission paid to referrers in the same transaction, if a referral code is applied.
Protocol fee deducted from the output token of each executed order. The rate is signed by the maker as part of the order and capped on-chain at 1%.
All the protocol fees deducted from the output token of each executed order. The router has no liquidity providers, so nothing is shared out.
None. Liquidity is Uniswap's; its pool fees are not counted here.
All creation and trading fees paid by BowYard users, denominated in USDG.
USDG token-creation fees plus all trading fees from BowYard's classic and Agent bonding curves and post-graduation DEX pools.
Fees paid to the BowYard protocol treasury: the full classic token-creation fee, the classic protocol share of curve/DEX fees, and the immutable 20% protocol share of Agent trading fees.
The full classic token-creation fee, the classic protocol share of curve/DEX fees, and 20% of Agent trading fees.
Classic creator fee shares plus the Agent market shares routed to creators, operating recipients, and attributed ecosystem recipients.
1% swap fees from bow.fun factory-launched Uniswap V3 pools on Robinhood Chain, filtered for pools with at least $1,000 TVL.
65% of swap fees retained by the bow.fun protocol, filtered for pools with at least $1,000 TVL.
35% of swap fees routed to launched-token creators, filtered for pools with at least $1,000 TVL.
Swap fees paid by traders on Jupiter Lend DEX pools.
Jupiter's share of the protocol cut of swap fees.
Swap fees kept by liquidity providers, and Fluid's share of the protocol cut.

Total fees paid by users on AGNT: (1) the 1.095% Doppler V4 terminal pool fee on tokens launched via the launchpad on Base + Robinhood Chain, derived from the observed on-chain platform fee share (WETH on Base; WETH plus RWA numeraires — tokenized stocks like AAPL that a Robinhood launch pairs against, e.g. $BEER — on Robinhood, priced by DefiLlama; the unpriced launched-token leg is excluded, a conservative lower bound); plus (2) the 0.40% platform fee on in-app swaps (Base), measured as WETH + USDC paid by Relay to AGNT's app-fee recipient wallet; plus (3) fees from PonsV2 launches on Robinhood Chain, read from each token's AgntFeeWedge Split events (native-ETH leg = total user-paid fee); plus (4) native-ETH paid by buyers to mint AGNT's own AGNTS PFP collection on Robinhood Chain; plus (5) AGNTS activation fees on Robinhood Chain (ETH fee + $AGNTS cost, from the Activated event); plus (6) AGNTS NFT swap fees on Robinhood Chain (random packs and exact picks; the fee is read from the swap engine at each swap's block).

Fees kept by AGNT: the 32% platform share of launchpad pool fees (WETH released by the Doppler initializers on Base + Robinhood, to 0x5bF5805e…C5f0) plus 100% of the 0.40% swap fee (WETH + USDC paid by Relay on Base to the app-fee recipient wallets — 0x585b6854…0598 pre-repoint and 0x5bF5805e…C5f0 post-repoint) plus AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) protocol cut of PonsV2 launch fees on Robinhood (the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split; the remaining 5/7 is forwarded to each token's own engine) plus 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds on Robinhood (a first-party collection, so there is no creator split) plus 100% of AGNTS activation ETH fees and swap fees, and the full $AGNTS activation cost (the treasury share plus the burned share).
Revenue kept by the AGNT treasury: everything in Revenue except the burned share of the $AGNTS activation cost.
The 68% of launchpad pool fees paid to third-party token creators (63%) and the Doppler protocol (~5%), estimated from the observed platform WETH share.
The share of each AGNTS activation's $AGNTS cost that is burned (burnBps, 50% today).
The 10% rake taken from every round's wagers: 8% distributed to veNFT stakers plus 2% routed to the vault.
All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veNFT stakers (RewardDistributed events on CashVoteEscrowStaking).
The 2% of wagers routed to the vault pool, which is paid back out to winning players.
All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veNFT stakers.
Same as Fees — both the admin fee and the rake are paid by players out of what they planted.

Every plant pays an admin fee at the configured adminFeeBps rate (1% at time of writing) on the AAPL it buys — taken inside the plant on v1, and at the round's seal on v2 (where AAPL-denominated plants pay the same rate on their value and batched plants an extra batchFeeBps, 0 at time of writing). Every revealed round with a winner pays that round's configured rakeBps on the loss pool (the stakes on the 24 plots that did not bloom), split into a fixed 10% to SEED stakers (STAKERS_BPS, a contract constant), the round's configured jackpotBps share to the Golden Apple jackpot, and the remainder to the treasury. Rounds where the blooming plot is empty take no rake — the whole pot rolls into the jackpot.
Gross profit: the admin fee plus the stakers and treasury cuts of the rake. The jackpot cut is excluded because it is paid back out to players.
The admin fee, withdrawn by the owner via collectAdmin: reconstructed per plant on v1, and on v2 measured as the growth of adminAccrued over the window plus the amounts withdrawn inside it.
The round's configured jackpotBps share of its rake, routed to the Golden Apple jackpot and paid back out to players when it hits.
Value reaching SEED holders: the fixed 10% of each round's rake flushed to SeedStaking as AAPL yield for stakers, plus the treasury remainder that buys SEED back on the DEX and burns it.

The 12% taken from every mining round's pot (8% to LUNA stakers, 2% to the Motherlode jackpot, 1% to the Eclipse prize pool, 1% to the protocol), plus the 15% taken from every Eclipse beacon purchase (10% to stakers, 5% to the protocol).
ETH distributed to LUNA stakers plus the protocol's retained cut.
The 1% of each mining round pot and 5% of each Eclipse beacon purchase retained by the protocol.
The 2% Motherlode jackpot and 1% Eclipse prize pool funded by each mining round, both paid back out to players.
ETH distributed to LUNA stakers — 8% of each mining round pot and 10% of each beacon purchase.
cardSales (card pack sales) - cardBuybacks (card repurchases) + otherFees (platform fees).
Net revenue retained by the protocol after buybacks.
Revenue kept by the protocol.
Revenue allocated to suppliers/partners (currently 0).
Protocol fee charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps, always collected in ETH or USDG (ProtocolFeeCharged events), converted to USD.
All the fees charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps are retained by the protocol.
100% of the fees charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps are retained by the protocol.
Users pay each pool's configured fee tier on every swap.
No protocol fee is taken, all swap fees go to liquidity providers.
No protocol fee is taken.
100% of swap fees are distributed to liquidity providers.
Gross USDC product payments (subscriptions, pay-per-deploy, Architect builds, first-party agent income) entering the on-chain revenue splitter, summed from PaymentSplit events.
The protocol's share of every payment — operating, dev, protocol-owned-liquidity reserve and DAO buckets — i.e. gross payments minus third-party affiliate payouts.
Same as Revenue: all non-affiliate buckets are protocol-controlled.
The 3-level affiliate share (6% / 2.5% / 1.5%) credited to third-party referrers, from AffiliateCredited events.
Trade fees on every buy and sell, read directly from the Buy/Sell `fee` field emitted by the contract.
Protocol share of trade fees: total fees minus creator cuts emitted via CreatorFeeAccrued.
Creator share of trade fees, read directly from CreatorFeeAccrued events, claimable by each token's creator.
Swap fees charged by the KOLSwap protocol.
Protocol fee routed to the protocol fee router.
Protocol fee routed to the KOLMarket protocol fee router.
Creator fee routed to the creator allocation and LP fee paid to liquidity providers.
Borrow interest paid by borrowers on Bitcoin-collateralised USDC loans.
Protocol reserve share of borrow interest (reserveRateBps), from the protocolCut field of the InterestAccrued event.
Borrow interest distributed to USDC liquidity providers (LPs), from the lenderCut field of the InterestAccrued event.
Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.
All ERC-20 payments (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the Yieldzio fee wallet are counted as fees.
100% of fees (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the fee wallet are protocol revenue.

Users pay a 1% fee in ETH on every bonding-curve buy and sell, plus a one-time 0.001 ETH launch fee per token. After a token graduates (6.9 ETH raised) its liquidity is locked in a full-range Uniswap V3 position whose LP fees accrue to the protocol.
70% of bonding-curve trading fees, all launch fees (0.001 ETH per token), and the claimed LP fees of graduated tokens' locked liquidity positions.
70% of the 1% bonding-curve trading fee, all launch fees (0.001 ETH per token), and the claimed LP fees of graduated tokens' locked liquidity positions.
30% of bonding-curve trading fees, paid instantly to token creators.
Trading fees paid by users on card buys/sells
Trading fees paid by users on card buys/sells (pack primary-mint proceeds are counted as volume, not fees)
Trading fees retained by the protocol treasury — fees minus the prize-pool, referral, and creator payouts

100% of collected fees(trading fees + launch fees) are retained by the protocol. Creator and deployer fees are claimed directly on-chain by those wallets and never reach the protocol fee wallets, so they are not counted.
100% of collected fees(trading fees + launch fees). Discretionary downstream spending of that revenue (Parabola and Topblast Friday tournament prize pools) is not a holder or LP distribution.
0 — bonding-curve venue, no fees are shared with liquidity providers.
0 — no fees are distributed to token holders.
$KINS paid by players: full paid-spinner payments (50% burned, 50% to treasury) plus the 5% treasury fee on marketplace gold-for-$KINS sales.
All fees accrue to the protocol side: burned $KINS plus $KINS retained by treasury.
$KINS retained by treasury (50% of spins and 5% of marketplace sales).
50% of every paid spinner payment is burned, reducing $KINS supply.
Gross gaming revenue: the total staked by players in settled rounds minus the total paid out to them.
Performance fee taken by the protocol on the bankroll's profit above its high water mark (50% of the eligible gain).
All of the performance fee goes to the protocol operator.
Gross gaming revenue left to the bankroll liquidity providers, accruing to the ASTROLP share price.
Builder code fees paid by users on Hyperliquid perps trades executed through Quote.
Builder code fees collected by Quote from Hyperliquid perps trades.
Users pay each pool's configured fee tier (0.05%, 0.3% or 1%) on every swap.
No protocol fee is taken (feeProtocol is 0 on every pool), all swap fees go to liquidity providers.
Users pay a 0.3% fee on every swap.
No protocol fee is taken (factory feeTo is unset), all swap fees go to liquidity providers.
10% of collected fees is protocol revenue.
10% of collected fees goes to the protocol.
90% of collected fees is distributed to LPs.
1.50% of the ETH leg of every trade, taken by the InstantHook and split between creators and the Agen treasury.
Agen treasury's 0.50% share of every trade, credited to the platform.
1.00% of every trade earned by the token creator.
The same 1.50%. It is the whole of what a trader pays on a user.fun trade.

1.50% of every bonding curve trade, charged on the quote side. Covers all four legs the curve program reports: the user.fun partner share, the coin creator share, Meteora's protocol share and the referral share paid to whichever interface hosted the swap.

The user.fun partner share only, which is 0.90% of a trade: the 1.20% the curve accumulates after Meteora's protocol share, less the coin creator's 25% of it. user.fun's own configuration records an effective rate of 0.96%, which is this 0.90% plus the 0.06% referral leg Meteora returns to whichever interface hosted the swap. That leg is counted in Fees and not here, because the swap event does not name the referral account and so cannot show which trades it was ours to claim.
Same as Revenue (0.9% of the trade). user.fun has no separate holder or treasury leg on chain.

Everything user.fun does not keep, which is 0.60% of a trade: the coin creator's 25% of the 1.20% curve fee, plus Meteora's 0.30% protocol share and the referral leg inside it paid to whichever interface hosted the swap.

Per-coin trading fees of 1%-4% per side, chosen by each creator at launch and immutable afterwards, the 0.25% trader/holder reward leg when a RewardVault is wired, and the fixed rewards paid out when a coin graduates. The share of each fee used to buy back and burn the launched coin is netted out rather than counted.
The protocol's share of trading fees, including the portion deferred until a coin graduates and the 25% treasury cut of above-default fee tiers, plus the protocol's graduation reward.
All protocol revenue is retained by the treasury. The live deployment has no on-chain path routing any of it to token holders, so none is booked as holders revenue.
The creator's share of trading fees and their graduation reward, the share minted into that coin's permanent buy wall, and the 0.25% reward leg paid out to traders and coin holders.
Includes Pump.fun creator/partner fee shares earned on every coin launched using the protocol and $ANSEM tokens burned to unlock launch tiers.
Captured pump.fun fee shares and platform payments plus $ANSEM tier burns.
Captured pump.fun fee shares and platform payments kept by the Ansem.io treasury.
$ANSEM permanently burned for Gold/Diamond launch tiers, accruing to remaining $ANSEM holders.
Trading fees paid by users on Hyperliquid markets deployed by Entropy.
Report submission fees and identity verification fees paid by security researchers to Immunefi's fee collector wallet.
All fees collected go to Immunefi.
Swap fees paid by traders across all STONX Ve33 pools.
All STONX Ve33 swap fees are routed to veSTONX voters. The protocol treasury takes no share.
Zero. The protocol treasury takes no share of STONX Ve33 swap fees.
Zero. Liquidity providers receive STONX emissions rather than a share of swap fees.
All swap fees are allocated to veSTONX voters in proportion to the voting power assigned to each pool.

Total LP trading fees claimed by managed positions (Meteora DLMM and DAMM v2 on Solana, Uniswap V3 on Robinhood Chain). LP Agent's on-chain footprint is only the 8% commission, so gross claimed fees are back-calculated as commission / 0.08.

The 8% commission LP Agent takes on claimed LP fees — at claim time and on the fee portion of a decrease or close, never on position principal. Measured as transfers into the per-chain fee wallet. LP Agent retains all of it.
The 8% commission retained by LP Agent. There is no token, no holder split, and no on-chain distribution of this inflow.
The remaining 92% of claimed LP fees, which stay in the user's own wallet.

Hook fees charged on the quote leg of every swap in Coinbarrel-launched Uniswap V4 pools (flat platform fee plus the creator-configured fee, read per swap from the hook's QuoteFeeAccrued event), Uniswap LP fees swept from the permanently locked launch positions, the fixed 0.0005 ETH launch service fee, and the legacy pre-V5 streams: the 1% LP fee on the Simple launches' Uniswap V3 pools and the per-swap fees of the legacy Advanced hooks.

The platform share that ends up in the Coinbarrel treasury: the platform bucket of the hook fee (counted when it accrues; the fee router pays it out in batches), the treasury share of LP fees (30% on Simple launches, per the FeeLocker split), and launch fees. Nothing of the creator fee reaches Coinbarrel.
Same as Revenue; Coinbarrel has no token buyback or holder distribution.

The creator-configured fee, which goes entirely to the launched token's side: creator revenue recipients, holder rewards, reinvestment into the pool, or burn; plus the creator/project share of LP fees.

Users and autonomous agents pay fee_bps (StreamService::GetConfig, currently 250 = 2.5%) on StreamCore deposits and bounded per-window settlements across BountyAdapter (including Agent Society ACP splits and StonkBase 1x spot margin flows).
100% of the 2.5% streaming and settlement fee is routed to the GrowStreams protocol treasury.

All user-paid slices on key trades and fund dispatch: platform + creator + trading-fund + $3 dispatch. Exclusive of bonding-curve price. Performance / bridge fees on FriendStake clones are not counted in v1 (beacon clones; 0 recent distributions).
Platform slices of key-trade fees plus flat dispatch fees paid to the protocol treasury.
Same as Revenue — platform key-trade fees and dispatch fees to treasury.
Creator rewards plus the trading-fund pull. Staker payouts are not fees.
Identical to Fees. Traders pay the swap fee; Umia takes no fee on a launch.

Swap fees on each venture's Uniswap v4 spot pool, booked in the money token at each swap's realised price, plus the fees of the winning proposal in each decision market, recognised when its protocol cut is collected after settlement. Fees paid on losing proposals never become real tokens and are not counted.
What accrues to the protocol fee recipient: the protocol cut of spot and winning-proposal decision-market fees, plus the recipient's share of the LP half through vault shares it holds.
Identical to Revenue. All of it accrues to the protocol fee recipient.
The LP half of spot and winning-proposal decision-market fees accruing to each venture's SpotLiquidityVault, less the fee recipient's share.
None. No buyback, burn or staker distribution exists on-chain.
Everything paid to trade on Ride Markets, in USDC: a fee when a trade is opened, a fee when it settles, and the share of the profit paid to the caller who deployed the trade.
The opening and settlement fees, which the protocol keeps.
The profit share paid to callers, which never reaches the protocol.
Yield generated by mxHYPE's borrowed-USDC overlay on Hyperliquid Core, measured in HYPE at distribution via the HypeVault's YieldDistributed event, plus instant redeem/unstake fees paid by users.
Share of distributed yield routed to the foundation, plus instant redeem/unstake fees. The insurance-fund share is booked as supply-side revenue because it backstops the system.
Revenue kept by the protocol. Monetrix has no token holder distribution, so protocol revenue equals the foundation share plus instant redeem/unstake fees.
Share of distributed yield paid to smxHYPE stakers, plus the insurance-fund reserve that backstops the system.
Staking rewards from staked SOL on phase delegation staked solana, plus withdrawal fees. Also counts the Jito MEV tips claimed by the pool's stake accounts
5% epoch fee on staking rewards plus 0.05% withdrawal fees collected by the fee collector
95% of the staking rewards go to stakers
Treasury-bound pair commission (swap + book take + limit place) plus labeled wrap/window fees. spread_amount and community-tax extra-debit are not fees.
Treasury commission credited to the protocol on swaps, book takes, limit placements, wrap/unwrap, and UST1 mint/redeem. Excludes LP spread and community-tax debits.
Net protocol income from treasury-bound commissions on trading and ancillary services (wrap/unwrap, UST1 window). No share is routed to LPs or token holders.
0 — LPs earn inventory/spread, not a transferred commission.
All tracked bonding-curve fees are paid directly by traders.
Platform fees and launch taxes paid by users trading on Ignix bonding curves.
The platform-fee portion retained by Ignix.
All Ignix revenue (platform fees portion) accrues to the protocol.
Launch taxes and anti-snipe fees allocated to launch creators and token-holder vaults.
Successful mainnet round-settlement fees calculated from the BidGrid ResetEvent allocation fields. User deposits, payouts and premine transfers are not counted as fees.
Gross profit from BidGrid round fees after excluding the jackpot amount paid back to winning miners.
The 1.5% protocol fee from each round's total deployed SOL, retained as the protocol treasury allocation.
The jackpot allocation paid back to winning miners from the non-winning-tile fee.
Round-fee allocations assigned to BDGR buybacks, BDGR staking rewards and the Burn Pot.
Name registration and renewal fees for .robin names (annual rentals, plus temporary Dutch-auction premiums on recently expired names), paid in ETH or USDG or ROBIN.
Same as fees: 100% of registration and renewal costs accrue to the protocol treasury (a 2-of-3 Safe). There are no third-party fee splits.
Same as revenue (100% of registration and renewal costs) — all fees accrue to the protocol treasury.
0.05% protocol fee deducted from order inputs at placement.
The 0.05% protocol fee, retained by the gateway.

Swap fees charged on Hookers launches, in native ETH. A creator picks a launch style from the protocol's mechanism registry. Hooked styles skim a directional buy/sell fee inside the hook, set by the creator between 100 and 1000 bps. Hookless styles use the pool's own Uniswap v4 LP fee, collected through LiquidityCustody. The registry is read on chain, so styles added later are included automatically.
The 30 bps protocol fee routed to FeeRouter, plus the share spent buying back and burning HKRS, the protocol's own token.
A flat 30 bps of trade volume routed to FeeRouter. It is carved out of the creator's advertised fee rather than added on top, and applies identically to every launch style.
Fees paid out to launch creators: the creator-nominated fee slots on creator-fee styles, LP fees on hookless styles, and buyback and burn on third-party launches.

HKRS bought back and burned, valued in ETH. This covers the automatic buyback hook on the HKRS pool, plus the discretionary buybacks the team runs out of the protocol's fee share, which are measured from the HKRS burned and priced from the HKRS pool. Buybacks on third-party launches are excluded and counted as supply side, since they accrue to those tokens' holders. Discretionary buybacks are funded from fees already counted as protocol revenue, so this figure overlaps ProtocolRevenue rather than adding to Revenue.
Same as Fees: all swap fees are paid by traders.
Swap fees charged by Cantex pools (pool fee rate applied to each swap), denominated in CC.
The protocol's share of swap fees (per-pool admin fee share).
The liquidity providers' share of swap fees.

All fee legs charged on trades, measured from on-chain token transfers out of the router: protocol commission (including captured surplus), aggregation fees, keeper execution fees and referral fees. All fees are paid by traders out of trade proceeds.
Protocol commission and aggregation fees, both collected by protocol-owned collectors.
All revenue accrues to the protocol treasury (FeeVault and aggregation collector); there is no token.
Keeper execution fees paid to order executors and referral fees paid to third-party referrers/integrators (permissionless rev-share).
All position, borrowing, liquidation, and UI fees actually paid by traders after referral discounts.
Position fees paid after trading discounts, plus borrowing, liquidation, and UI fees. Funding transfers between traders are excluded.
The position, borrowing, and liquidation fee amounts accrued as claimable protocol fees and withdrawable through FeeHandler.
The protocol fee share of position, borrowing, and liquidation fees held through FeeHandler.
Fees allocated to LPs, affiliates, UI integrators, and the credit fee claim vault.
Same as fees — traders pay both the maker and taker legs.

Maker and taker trading fees on Native Core CLOB fills. Each side pays independently, so both legs are counted. Taken from GET /api/v3/stats/window over the hour. Settlement assets are recorded under their Native Core registry token; CLOB-only synthetic assets without a canonical token are valued from their USDC/USDT market.

Maker and taker fees Native retains after subtracting Native Pool yield distributed to LPs. Revenue can be negative in a distribution hour because Pool payouts include extra rewards as well as fee-funded yield.
Native Pool yield paid to LPs, from POST /api/v3/earn distributions. This includes fee-funded yield and extra rewards.
XAGm custody fees and redemption fees.
XAGm custody and redemption fees accounted as protocol revenue.
veRAPH voters’ take: staked-LP swap fees forwarded to voters plus external bribes. Equals HoldersRevenue — Raphael keeps no treasury cut of swap fees.
Swap fees kept by unstaked LPs (fee × (1 − stakedShare)). LPs who stake in the gauge forgo these fees in exchange for RAPH emissions.
Swap fees from staked LPs (fee × pool.balanceOf(gauge) / pool.totalSupply), forwarded to veRAPH voters, plus external bribes.
2% protocol fee charged on each settlement (jobs via escrow, campaigns via campaign vault), paid in USDC/USDT to the protocol fee recipient.
100% of protocol fees (2% of settlements) go to the protocol fee recipient.
Same as revenue — the full 2% settlement fee.
1% pool swap fee on every trade, accruing to permanently locked Uniswap V4 positions and periodically swept to creators and the protocol, plus a 0.0005 ETH launch fee paid at each token deployment.
30% of collected swap fees credited to the treasury claimable balance, plus the full 0.0005 ETH launch fee paid to the protocol treasury at launch.
70% of collected swap fees credited to the creator claimable balance when fees are collected and allocated.
Same as Fees. Every fee is paid by a trader or a coin creator.

Trading fees paid by users on swaps routed through the Archade app, plus bonding curve trade fees and pool creation fees on coins launched through Archade. Fees after a coin graduates to a DEX pool are not included yet.
Archade's platform fee on app swaps, its share of bonding curve trade fees, and its share of pool creation fees.
Same as Revenue. All of it goes to the Archade treasury.
Fees paid to coin creators, affiliate partners and the bonding curve program.
None. Archade has no token.
SOL fees paid by users for Rapid Launch token deployment and trading tools.
86% of collector fees, kept by Rapid Launch after the 14% referral split.
14% of collector fees, distributed to referral recipients.
Traders pay a 1.5% fee on the quote-asset leg of every swap in a SolStocker pool. The pool's own LP fee is zero — the SolStockerFeeHook takes the whole fee.

The 1.5% swap fee charged by SolStockerFeeHook on every swap in a SolStocker-launched Uniswap v4 pool, read per swap from the five slices of the FeeCharged event and denominated in the pool's quote asset (a tokenized equity such as SPCX or NVDA). There is no launch fee and no graduation fee.
The 0.30% platform slice plus the 0.15% slice owed to STOCKER holders — 0.45% of the trade, 30% of the fee.
The 0.30% platform slice of the swap fee — 20% of the fee.
The 1.05% routed to third parties — 0.75% to holders of the launched coin, 0.15% to that coin's creator and 0.15% to the trader rebate pool.

The 0.15% slice accruing to holders of STOCKER, SolStocker's own token — 10% of the fee. It accrues to a dedicated recipient separate from platform revenue and is settled to STOCKER holders on Solana.

Everything borrowers pay: the flat fee charged when a loan is opened or extended, penalties paid when a loan is cured after its grace period, and the protocol's cut of any appreciation on yield-bearing collateral. Lodestar charges no interest, so nothing accrues over the life of a loan.
The portion of the above kept by the protocol: the reserve cut of borrower fees, plus all penalties and all collateral yield skim.
The portion kept by the protocol, routed to the first-loss reserve that absorbs settlement shortfalls before lenders do.
The portion of borrower fees paid through to lenders in the USDT0 pool, taken from the amount the loan book actually locks for them rather than recomputed from the fee rate.
Swap fees paid by traders on every Ilyris swap.
Swap fees paid by traders on every Ilyris swap, a base fee per pool plus a variable fee that rises while the market is volatile.
The protocol's share of swap fees (10% on every pool since launch), sent to the pool's fee recipient wallet.
The protocol's share of swap fees (10% on every pool since launch), sent to the pool's fee recipient.
The remaining 90% of swap fees, which stay in the bins and accrue to liquidity providers.
Settlement FeeCollected plus partner fees on tagged CoW, UniswapX, and Velora fills.
100% of Settlement, UniswapX, and Velora fees. 75% of CoW partner fees (CIP-75).
100% of Settlement, UniswapX, and Velora fees and 75% of CoW partner fees, paid to the Settlement fee recipient.
CoW's 25% CIP-75 share of tagged partner fees.

Loopr basket mint fees (paid in-kind by minters, in the basket's own constituent tokens), the LOOPR-token creator + protocol tax collected via launchpad hook, and ETH deposited into Loopr's community vault.
Loopr's 30% cut of each basket's mint fee, the LOOPR token creator + protocol tax paid to Loopr's own wallet, and ETH deposited into Loopr's community vault.
The 70% of each basket's mint fee paid to that specific basket's own (possibly third-party, permissionless) creator.

Pez curve trade fees and creator taxes on every launched token, plus the graduated Uniswap v4 pool fees of the PEZ platform token, realized through PoolFeesSwept events. Other graduated pools are counted under the Uniswap v4 listing. Pez's current deployment has no launch fee.
Protocol revenue plus holders revenue.
Any protocol fee share read from the on-chain fee policy (zero under the current policy), plus the creator fees and taxes of the PEZ token, which the Pez team launched and collects on.
Creator fee, creator tax, and launched-token buyback amounts paid from curve fees of third-party launched tokens.
PEZ buyback-and-lock amounts reported by PoolFeesSwept for the PEZ pool. No such buyback has happened on-chain so far, so this is currently zero.
0.25% protocol fee per swap, taken in ETH when ETH/WETH is on either side, otherwise in the output token.
All fees (0.25% of the swap volume) go to the protocol treasury.
All swap fees(0.25% of the swap volume) are retained by the protocol treasury.
Swap fees paid by traders. Locker distributions are not user fees.

Swap fees on the listed DLMM and DAMM factories plus WETH credited to U1 lockers. Excludes aggregator, keeper, flash-loan and liquidity-composition fees. DLMM uses SwapDetailed; DAMM uses changes in protocol and LP fee accumulators plus claims, in each historical fee token.
The protocol's share of swap fees accruing to the fee recipient, plus WETH credited to U1 lockers (including external funding).
Gross protocol swap-fee share accruing to the fee treasury.
The share of swap fees that accrues to liquidity providers.

Actual WETH distributions credited to U1 lockers (Base) by RewardsAdded, including external funding. Counted in Fees and Revenue at funding time, not again when users claim. No fixed forwarding percentage is assumed.

AMM swap commission only: for each hourly volume_bucket on factory pairs (reflective + cumulative), fee = offer_volume * live pair.commission_rate (fee asset = offer asset). Excludes token_bonding wrap/unwrap and converter pairs. $WESO cw20_bonding curve tax_collected is cumulative-only (project_tax_pct 10) with no time-bucketed query, so curve taxes are NOT included. Buckets retain at most 168 hours.

fee_collector_share_permille of the AMM commission (live per pair; sampled pairs are 1000 = 100%) sent to fee_collector terra1wkdm6wcm4srahrvp09jea7csfq3yuacc4gmyft6p6n6pls9wy5js9lqhqq. No separate LP share of this commission field is counted — reflective pools may compensate LPs via the curve, not this commission — so SupplySideRevenue is omitted.
Same as Revenue: at current on-chain shares the counted AMM commission accrues to the fee collector / protocol.
Trading commission collected on perp trades (funding payments excluded).
Trading commission retained by the protocol after referral rebates (fees − rebates).
Trading commission retained by the Jetbit protocol treasury (fees − referral rebates).
Referral rebates — trading commission paid back out to referrers.
Taker trading fees: each market's taker_fee_ppm (0.1% on most markets) applied to that market's volume. Maker fees are not charged to takers and are excluded.
All trading fees are collected by the protocol. Partner commissions and trader fee rebates are paid from the treasury after the fact and are not netted here.
Same as Revenue: the protocol treasury receives all trading fees.
Same as Fees; traders pay all three components.

Swap fees paid by traders on the protocol's BUCKET/ETH Uniswap v4 pool: the 1% LP fee plus the BucketFeeHook's 3% Treasury fee (FEE_BPS is a verified on-chain constant), both measured on the ETH leg of each Swap event; plus the Stockback router's 0.5% input fee (exact per-swap amount from its Swapped event).
The hook's 3% Treasury fee, the 1% LP fee (the pool's liquidity is protocol-owned and permanently locked), and the protocol half of Stockback router fees.
The 1% LP fee, accruing to the protocol's permanently locked liquidity position.
The trader's half of every Stockback router fee, credited back as stock rewards.

The hook's 3% Treasury fee plus the protocol half of router fees: this is the stream the payout engine converts into tokenized stocks delivered to BUCKET holder wallets. Keeper gas for those deliveries is paid from this stream and varies with chain conditions; it is not modeled as a fixed split.
Same as Fees: paid by traders on curve trades.
Trading fees charged on every curve buy and sell (1% of the quote amount on the active preset: 0.8% creator, 0.2% protocol).
Protocol share of curve trading fees (0.2%).
Creator share of curve trading fees (0.8%), paid to the token creator's fee recipient.

Protocol and creator trading fees directly paid by bonding-curve traders. Graduation fees are excluded because they are deducted from the curve reserve before migration rather than charged directly to an end-user.

Actual protocol and creator trading fees from Trade, plus the graduationFee from Graduated. Accrual basis in native SHIDO, valued using its 1:1 WSHIDO wrapper. No fixed fee-rate estimates, claim double-counting, gas fees or post-graduation fees.
Protocol trading fees plus graduation fees, excluding the creator trading-fee share and all post-graduation revenue.

Same as Revenue (protocol trading fees + graduation fees): fees allocated to the protocol when accrued at the factory. Subsequent treasury spending or announced buybacks are not measured by this adapter.
Creator trading fees accrued by Trade events. This is creator income, not LP fees or revenue of holders of the Bubble Protocol token.
The round protocol fee paid by tile bidders plus the winning ad auction bids paid by advertisers in SOL or ATTN.

The protocol fee taken from every round's tile deposits (10% at launch, read per round from the RoundClosed event) plus the full winning bid of every weekly tile ad auction, paid in SOL or ATTN. Player deposits are paid out to winning bidders and are not counted.
The round protocol fee plus 10% of each winning SOL ad bid and all of each winning ATTN ad bid, sent to the protocol treasury.
All revenue stays in the protocol treasury; its use (buybacks, staking rewards, build budget) is decided off-chain and not tracked here.
The 90% of each winning SOL ad bid forwarded into that tile's jackpot vault, paid to the tile's bidders on a jackpot hit.
Builder code fees paid on Hyperliquid trades routed through AlphaPilot; excludes Hyperliquid exchange trading fees.
Builder code fees collected by AlphaPilot from Hyperliquid trades.
The protocol receives 20% of the fees paid by users.
80% of user jetton fees are distributed among LPs, based on the amount of user liquidity utilized in a particular swap.
Native ETH creator rewards claimed from PonsV2FeeEscrow for World is Flat ($WIF).
100% of claimed Pons creator rewards are retained by the WIF treasury.
All claimed Pons creator rewards flow to the WIF treasury.

Everything borrowers and traders pay on gage: the deal or origination fee taken when a loan funds, trade fees on sold reclaim rights and lender units, the cash-out platform fee, and the borrower's fixed cost paid to lenders at repayment (repayment cap minus principal). Fixed-cost loans have no interest accrual: the cost is booked when the loan is repaid. Intent lend-asset generations lend a stock token, and their amounts are in that token.

Deal, origination, trade and cash-out fees, the Earn performance fee on lender returns, and on Intent V1 the execution fee each fill takes from the partner vaults' return and the protocol's 10% of a partner vault's performance fee.
The Earn performance fee (curator and protocol shares).

The borrower's fixed cost paid to lenders at repayment, before the Earn performance fee, the Intent execution fee and partner vault performance fees for loans an Earn strategy or a partner vault funded.

Deal, origination, trade and cash-out fees, the Intent execution fee and the protocol's share of partner vault performance fees: since D57 every one of them buys GAGE for the permanent GAGE-only floor bands of the GAGE/sGAGE pool.
The protocol fee on every referral bounty that pays out: 10% of the reward, paid by the referrer.
All protocol fees (10% of referral rewards) go to the ref_market treasury.
Swap fees (1% of the swap) and optional creator tax charged by the Cook hook on every swap, before and after graduation, there is no launch fee
Part of the swap fees (protocolFeeShareBps, 10% at launch) sent to the Cook treasury
Remaining swap fees and 100% of the creator tax paid to token creators
Includes 2% property NFT sale fees and interest earned from property NFTs.
Includes 2% property NFT sale fees and 10% of interest earned from property NFTs.
Includes 90% of interest earned from property NFTs paid to NFT owners.

The tax BaseStonk's Uniswap v4 hook takes on every swap in a launched token's pool, from the hook's FeeTaken event. Each launch sets its own buy and sell rate. A buy pays the tax in the launch token and a sell in the pair; token-denominated amounts are converted into the pair at the pool price the same transaction's Swap reports.

The platform's cut of the tax plus what reaches BSTONK holders: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade to the treasury, any part of the creator's cut the payee list left unplaced and the hook swept to the treasury, and the share of the creator's cut paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor, to the BSTONK basket vault, or burnt as BSTONK.
The treasury's take: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade, plus unplaced creator fees swept to it.

The creator's cut of the tax less what the treasury swept and what reached BSTONK holders: the creator's wallets, the launch token's own holders through its dividend distributor, the burn of the launch token and the hook-owned liquidity wedge, as each launch configured them.

Value to BSTONK holders, paid by the hook in the transaction the fee was taken: BSTONK's own pool pays its creator cut to BSTONK's dividend distributor and burns half of it, and launches carry the BSTONK basket vault as a payee; the vault pays BSTONK holders in rounds. Base only - BSTONK lives on Base.

Gross LP trading fees claimed by Valhalla-managed Meteora DLMM positions. Each public Meteora claim event is counted only when its transaction contains Valhalla's matching post-workflow management-fee transfer; claim assets are measured directly, not inferred from a fee rate. DAMM v2 and opening fees are excluded.
All zERC20 fees are paid directly by users: v2 withdrawal and note-merge fees, and v1 redeem fees on private transfers and unwrap fees.

Fees users pay to move tokens privately: since 2026-10-20 a v2 withdrawal fee (0.35% below $10k, tapering to 0.08% above $10M) and a small fee for merging notes, plus on v1 a 0.35% redeem fee on private transfers (since 2026-06-02) and an unwrap fee for converting zTokens back to the underlying token that rises as liquidity runs low; relayer and third-party referral fees are excluded.
All v2 withdrawal and note-merge fees and all v1 redeem and unwrap fees paid by users are kept by the protocol.
All v2 withdrawal and note-merge fees and all v1 redeem and unwrap fees paid by users go to the protocol: v2 fees to its fee-recipient address, v1 fees as surplus backing in its liquidity reserves.
Total swap fees paid by traders. Per-pool fee rate read from CLPool.fee() applied to each swap's input amount.
veRAPH voters’ take: staked-LP swap fees plus the unstaked-LP rake (CLPool.unstakedFee), plus external bribes. Equals HoldersRevenue — Raphael keeps no treasury cut of swap fees.
Swap fees kept by unstaked liquidity providers, net of the unstaked-LP rake.
Fees earned by staked liquidity (CLPool.stakedLiquidity / liquidity) plus the rake taken from unstaked liquidity, forwarded to veRAPH voters, plus external bribes.
Same as Fees. Every one of the three flows is paid by a user: the miner pays the entry price, the trader pays the swap fee, and the secondary-market buyer pays the royalty.

Everything users pay the protocol: the price of every cat minted, the trading fee the hook takes on the $HASH pool, and the secondary-market royalty the collection routes to the hook. The mint price is derived per cat from the contract's own curve - the number of cats created so far times PRICE_STEP - rather than read from a transaction value, so a mint sent with excess ether cannot inflate it.
Fees minus the rent paid out to living cats.
The developer's share of revenue, at the hook's devBps rate, read from the chain rather than hardcoded.

Rent paid to the cats already alive. Every mint splits its price between the cats that came before it and the hook; cat holders are suppliers whose asset earns, not holders of a governance token, so their cut is a cost of revenue. Measured as the mint price minus the hook's cut, which is exact and needs no reconstruction from the rent accumulator. The hook's cut is what it was owed in the window rather than what it was sent: a transfer that fails its gas stipend is held in the collection's hookDue and forwarded later, so the change in that balance is added back.

The share of revenue that joins the hook's buyback queue and is spent buying $HASH back on the pool and burning it. Measured at the fee source - the moment the hook receives and splits the money - rather than when a buyback executes, since the queue is drained gradually under a per-block cap.
Flat SOL fees paid by users to create a token, manage a token, create an OpenBook market and bulk send tokens on DexLab, received by the DexLab fee wallet on Solana.
All fees (SOL paid by users to create a token, manage a token, create an OpenBook market and bulk send tokens on DexLab) are kept by DexLab. There is no supplier side and no token holder share.
Same as Fees. The hook fee and the tax are charged to swappers.

The 1% hook fee and the ~3.33% tax PonsV2MemeHook charges on every swap of the genesis SHROOM/MU pool, read from the hook's own sweep events and denominated in MU after the hook converts the SHROOM side. Neither rate is assumed: both come from the events, and the split between Pons and the creator is read from the hook at the block being priced.
SHROOM token revenue only: MU allocated for holder dividends in pool-filtered sweeps, excluding Pons. This is not treasury revenue and includes no treasury LP earnings.
The 30% of the hook fee taken by Pons, the launchpad the token was issued through.

MU allocated to all SHROOM holders from creatorAmount, recognized at the hook sweep. Actual recipient payments can occur later. Treasury holders are included in this token-wide allocation, so do not add treasury dividend receipts again.

Treasury income only: earned fees from treasury-owned SHROOM LP positions plus actual MU dividend receipts. Token balances and returned LP principal are not income. All-holder SHROOM dividend allocations are reported separately in shroom.ts; do not sum the two scopes.
Protocol fee plus judge fee, both charged on the pot when the winner claims.
The protocol fee share of claims, paid to the protocol fee collector.
Judge fees paid to the human judges who resolve bets.
Zero. There is no token.
Commission charged by the validators kHYPE delegates to, on the staking rewards they produce for kHYPE.
The half of that commission Kinetiq invoices back to each validator operator (invoice_rate_bps, 5000 to date).
None: the whole invoiced commission pays for KNTQ buybacks, so Kinetiq's treasury keeps none of it.
The half of the commission the validator operators retain for running the nodes.

All of the commission Kinetiq invoices to validator operators, used to buy back KNTQ. The bought KNTQ went to sKNTQ stakers until 2026-09-15 and has been sent to the Hyperliquid Assistance Fund since then (KIP-5, https://kinetiq.xyz/blog/kip-5-kntq-buybacks-assistance-fund).

Sum of `fee` fields from `OptionExercised` (settlement fee on each exercised leg) and `PositionClosed` (matched-pair close fee). Both are charged at `1 / sf_fee_divisor` of the exercised/closed collateral and paid in USDC.

Equal to Fees (sum of `OptionExercised` and `PositionClosed` fees): the protocol has no governance token, and every fee is transferred to the on-chain `feeCollector_address` (which the owner can rotate via `setFeeCollector` / `FeeCollectorChanged`).
Trading fees paid in KNTQ on Hyperliquid spot, which is the side of a KNTQ trade the HIP-1 deployer's share applies to.
All of the trading fees paid in KNTQ on Hyperliquid spot. deployerTradingFeeShare on KNTQ is 1.0, so the deployer collects the whole KNTQ-denominated fee.
None: Kinetiq sends every KNTQ it collects as the token's deployer to the Hyperliquid Assistance Fund and keeps none of it.
All of the trading fees paid in KNTQ on Hyperliquid spot, which the deployer sends to the Hyperliquid Assistance Fund; the fund has not sold or moved any of that KNTQ to date.

5.5% platform fee on marketplace resales + 2.5% platform fee on rental payments + the 2.5% creator royalty on resales, which is passed through to the original creator rather than kept by the protocol.
Only the treasury-bound platform fees (resale + rental). Excludes the creator royalty.
All treasury-bound platform fees (5.5% on resales and 2.5% on rentals). There is no token-holder split.
The 2.5% creator royalty on resales, paid to the original creator, not the protocol treasury.

Curve mode: 1% base fee plus optional creator tax on every bonding-curve buy/sell, plus the flat (owner-adjustable, re-read live) launch fee, plus post-graduation Uniswap v4 pool fees realised at sweep. Instant-v4 mode: the 1% LP fee of SolonPad's own plain Uniswap v4 launch pools, realised when the permissionless FeeSplitter crank forwards it.
Curve mode: the protocol's share of curve fees (per-token policy, read live) plus all launch fees. Instant-v4 mode: the ~50% of LP fees forwarded to the platform treasury.

Curve mode: the creator and buyback-vault shares of curve fees, the full creator tax, and the creator/buyback share of post-graduation pool fees. Instant-v4 mode: the ~50% of LP fees forwarded to the launch creator's BeneficiaryVault position.
Traders pay every swap fee.

Swap fees paid by traders: each swap's amount times its pool's fee rate. Pools with a dynamic-fee plugin set the rate inside every swap without emitting it, so the rate is read from slot0 at the end of each hourly window.
The protocol's share of swap fees, set per pool and per token in basis points of the fee.
The protocol's share of swap fees.
The part of swap fees the protocol does not take, which accrues to liquidity providers.
Creation fees, curve trading fees, anti-snipe surcharge, graduation fees, and leftover quote at graduation. Excludes Lunya DEX swap fees.
Creation fees, the protocol share of curve fees, the full anti-snipe surcharge, graduation fees minus the trigger reward, and leftover quote at graduation.
The same as Revenue.
Creator share of curve fees, and the graduation trigger reward.
Launch fees, curve trading fees, snipe tax, creator tax and swap fees from graduated Uniswap v3 pools (realised when swept).
All launch fees plus the protocol share of curve trading fees, snipe tax and graduated pool swap fees.
All revenue goes to the protocol fee recipient.
The creator share of curve trading fees, snipe tax and graduated pool swap fees, plus the full creator tax.
Trading fees from Peach bonding-curve trades and the launchpad's cut of graduated-pool LP fees, including creator tax, counted once when the fee accrues. Fees without a USD price are excluded.
The platform's own share of fees, after creator, partner, referral and launched-token buyback shares.
Same as Revenue - all of it goes to the protocol.
Creator, partner and referral shares of fees, plus the share allocated to launched-token buybacks. These launched tokens are not the Peach governance token.
The part paid by copyfomo users: service fee plus gas billed back. Excludes the $COPY creator fees, which are paid by $COPY traders.

Everything traders pay copyfomo on every copied buy and sell (a 2% service fee plus the gas copyfomo fronts for them, billed back as one stablecoin transfer to the copyfomo treasury, counted on the day the fee is collected), plus the creator fees of the copyfomo token $COPY: the Pons launchpad hook takes 3% of every swap of the COPY/COIN pool on Robinhood Chain, of which 2.7% goes to the creator (1% hook fee, 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax). Counted on the day of the trade, valued at the hourly COIN price. The fees are swept into COIN by Pons and claimed by copyfomo in batches later; the claims are not what is counted.

Fees minus SupplySideRevenue, i.e. after the EVM bundler gas, the Solana fee payer cost and referral rewards: the service fee plus copyfomo's margin on gas, plus the $COPY creator fees (the 'token fees' figure on copyfomo.com/data). The 'protocol fees, after gas' figure on copyfomo.com/data is the service part before referral rewards.
Revenue minus HoldersRevenue: service revenue and the creator fees kept by copyfomo.

Referral rewards paid to copyfomo referrers, plus the actual on-chain cost copyfomo pays on users' behalf: the EVM bundler gas and the SOL spent by the Solana fee payer (transaction fees and token-account rent).

Buyback & burn of $COPY, funded by the creator fees: what the copyfomo creator wallets pay (COIN or USDG) in every transaction where they buy $COPY from the pool and burn $COPY in the same transaction (the buyback account buys and burns in one user operation). Counted on the day of the buy, which follows the trades that generated the fees. A holder cashback leg (USDG distributed to $COPY holders) is planned and will be added when it goes live.
All fees are paid by users: the swap fee and the creator tax by traders, the launch fee by the creator.

Fees paid by users on heks: a fee on every swap in a launched coin's pool, plus the flat fee a creator pays to launch one. The swap fee is charged in the pool's pair asset. It is the protocol fee — 1% in steady state, higher in a launch's first ten seconds to price out snipers — plus, on coins launched from V2.2 whose creator set one, a creator tax of up to 10%. Both are read from the vault's own events: Collected carries the protocol fee and its split, TaxCredited the creator tax.
The protocol's 30% share of every swap's protocol fee, plus the launch fee in full. The creator tax is never shared with the protocol.
The protocol's 30% share of every swap's protocol fee, plus the launch fee in full. There is no heks token, so none of this is distributed to holders.

The 70% of every swap's protocol fee that goes to the coin's creator, plus the creator tax in full on coins that set one. A creator can redirect both to the holders of their own coin at launch; they leave the protocol either way.

Actual MON fees accrued to the protocol treasury and sent to the buyback vault at round settlement, plus separately paid auto-bet gas subsidies. Excludes MON allocated back to players and does not count gross stakes as fees.
MON round settlement fees retained by the treasury and buyback vault; excludes auto-bet execution fees paid to the gas-subsidy wallet.
MON round fees allocated directly to the protocol treasury; excludes gas subsidies, the separate buyback budget and GONE inventory valuations.
User-paid auto-bet execution fees transferred to the execution wallet as gas subsidies, included in Fees but excluded from Revenue; measures the subsidy paid, not actual transaction gas expenditure.

Successful GONE staking rewards funded by the buyback vault, valued in MON at the matching buyback's actual execution rate (MON spent / GONE bought), then priced in USD by the SDK. Includes pending rewards only when successfully funded; excludes mining allocations, no-staker treasury diversions, other funders and later claims. Execution-price valuation includes trading costs and is not an independent GONE market price.
USDC-side Uniswap V3 swap fees accrued on Tolly's locked launch pools. Excludes the project-token-side fee leg, which is burned outright but has no reliable USD price.
The 10% protocol-treasury share plus the 9% spent buying and burning TOLLY.
The 10% share paid to the treasury.
The 64% creator share, the 12% launched-token holder-reward share, and the 5% that buys and burns the launched token itself.
The 9% share market-bought back into TOLLY and burned.

1% total fee on every Sashimi bonding-curve trade, read directly from each trade's own fee amount, plus the flat 1 USDC launch fee. Excludes post-graduation Uniswap v3 fees, which are not yet tracked here.
60% of the curve trading fee, per the documented protocol/creator split, plus all launch fees.
